title: Kamishiro Rui — Rainbow☆Cast〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A few days after returning
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to say, I learned quite a lot during our trip to Riley Dream Park.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That show we saw clearly had the biggest impact on us, but...)
“Jungle Music” area

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But these trees are imitations...
And yet, it feels like we've wandered into a real jungle for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: We consulted with some botanists regarding how we could simulate the real thing. Those trees may be manmade, but they help create a very jungle-like atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Thanks to them, we were able to come very close to what we wanted. After that, we just had to build some waterfalls and research what jungles sound and even smell like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I always wonder how I can stimulate all five senses when I'm working on a show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (How things smell being one of them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, the Wonder Stage is ultimately an outdoor stage. As such, I've been avoiding ideas and effects that can be affected by the weather.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But rain and wind are natural to any jungle. The way they designed that area made it so the weather doesn't affect what people experience all that much.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So some of the smells they use aren't affected by rain, wind or weather in general?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If anything, rain would make that area feel even more like a real jungle.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Wait, that's it...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's not about avoiding bad weather. It's about having people experience the same place in different ways based on the weather...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. How foolish of me. I've been closing doors to new opportunities this whole time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, it's the director's job to make the impossible a reality...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...
A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're here, Rui.
What is it that you need us to try out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Where's Rui?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's not running late, is he?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, his garage was empty by the time I left my house, so he should be here already.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that means he's... Hey, look!
There's a name card on that seat over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's my name!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? This one says my name...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And mine's way over there.
So we're supposed to sit where we've been assigned...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Probably...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'm in my seat!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu's front and center, but we're in the back and off to each side.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! Look, we make a perfect triangle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, if you draw lines between us...
What in the world is Rui up to now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, I'm guessing that we're supposed to be the audience and Rui's gonna appear on stage to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, did you see something?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I smell something sweet!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sniff sniff*
I knew it! Flowers! And it's coming from the stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right...
I can smell it from here now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You can?
I can't smell anything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... It might be because you're upwind.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What if you breathed in really deep like this?
*Sniiifff*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What, like some sort of vacuum cleaner? Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sniff sniff*
I'm not smelling flowers. This seems like something else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, it smells like a forest...
It's as if trees are breathing all around me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's probably just the scent of a forest. Also, I really doubt trees breathe the way you're imagining them to right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can smell it now too!
It's really a forest!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's coming my way too.
Yeah, it really does smell like a forest...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But why's it a forest now? What happened to the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know the answer to that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! You've already begun your experiment, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Nicely done, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, it's Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
I apologize for not explaining things sooner, but my goal was to get some natural impressions of this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean from these smells?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, as it happens...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. An effect that stimulates a person's sense of smell...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'd been avoiding it all this time because of certain things that are out of our control, but I've decided to start experimenting with ideas like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In this case, I'm sure you all noticed that you'll smell different things at varying times depending on where you sit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So what's your verdict?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can we use this for our next show?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's not quite ready for the stage yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As it stands, there's still too much variation in terms of how and when these smells reach everybody in the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to keep experimenting with this to see how much I can fine-tune it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, are there any other ideas like this that you think we should test out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Test out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We'll certainly need to keep honing our craft to put on better shows, but I believe new and innovative ideas will also become necessary.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I won't be able to test these ideas on my own, so I'd really appreciate your help whenever possible... As I've been doing with Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Conversely, I'd like it if you could come to me for help as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Does that mean you'd be willing to make stuff for us if we ask?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
As long as it's within my power to do so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Sounds like a plan!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I actually came up with a whole bunch of ideas after we got back from our trip♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought really hard about what I can do to make them happen, but I'd love to hear what you think too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Gladly. It's sort of my forte, so please feel free to ask me whenever.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Can we take a look at some now?! Like... This one!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's have a look.
